relationships.subject: ELB00824
relationships.evidence_quote: ELB00824 treatment prevented oxaliplatin induced cold hyperalgesia and mechanical allodynia in a dose-dependent manner.

relationships.subject: ELB00824
relationships.evidence_quote: Preemptive i.p. injections of ELB00824 (30 mg/kg), but not pioglitazone (30 mg/kg), resulted in a significant reduction in spinal carbonyl, 3-nitrotyrosine and TBARS levels.

relationships.subject: ELB00824
relationships.evidence_quote: ELB00824 significantly inhibited oxaliplatin-induced firing in IB4− neurons, but paradoxically increased oxaliplatin-induced firing in IB4+ neurons

relationships.subject: T0070907
relationships.evidence_quote: Both T0070907 injected via i.p. and i.t significantly blocked the preventative effect of preemptive ELB00824 on OIPN

relationships.subject: ELB00824
relationships.evidence_quote: suggesting that ELB00824 likely acts on both central and peripheral PPARγ to mediate pain prevention in OIPN

key_findings: The BBB-penetrant PPARγ agonist ELB00824, but not pioglitazone, prevented oxaliplatin-induced cold and mechanical allodynia and spinal oxidative stress in mice.
ELB00824 suppressed oxaliplatin-induced firing in IB4- DRG neurons, showed a roughly 6-fold therapeutic window, and did not alter oxaliplatin anticancer activity in vitro.
